fato_historico: 1711: Britain's Quebec Expedition loses eight ships and almost nine hundred soldiers, sailors and women to rocks at Pointe-aux-Anglais.
energia_do_dia: Today, you may feel an urge to navigate through turbulent waters with grace. Just as those who once faced rocky shores, consider your resilience as your greatest strength. It is a good time to reflect on the lessons of the past while moving forward, perhaps finding hidden treasures in moments of challenge and refreshing your perspective on life's unpredictable journey.
frase_do_dia: Even the roughest seas can lead you toward your own beautiful, lucky clover field.
significado_numero: Represents the master builder of dreams and long-term vision.
conselho: Trust your intuition when navigating complex situations today, stay focused and stay hopeful.
